## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, previous behavior, and behavior after this change. Link relevant issues.

## Validation

List the commands/checks run and their results. Distinguish mocked tests from live Snyk runs.

## Review notes

Call out evidence/verification changes, compatibility or migration effects, and remaining limits.

- [ ] Behavior changes have regression coverage.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog match the final behavior.
- [ ] No tokens or confidential scan/repository data are included.
